parameters.toolDescription: Hand this customer to a human colleague in 2B Desk. Call it ONLY when: (complaint) something is broken, late, wrong, double-charged, or the customer is upset; (followup) they ask about an existing order, delivery, replacement or refund; (sales) they clearly commit to buying — call get_product_link first; (inquiry) they ask for a person, or you could not help after two tries. Never for browsing or price questions you can answer. The answer tells you: assigned (a colleague has it now), agents_ready (0 = nobody on shift), queue_position.
